protocol: docs/PROTOCOLE-EXPOSITION-v1.3.md, with the amendments of 17/10 (re-entry; TC44 and qualification)

TC44.definition: constant total target; same basket, caps, stops, re-entry rules, freezes, gate (risk_off seen) and execution as the candidate; a realised shortfall is never compensated

block_lengths.why: possible: its admissibility is read on the whole calibration
not possible: its continuous drawdown already exceeds 50 % on development, and it enters a verdict only if it respects the limit itself
not possible: non admissible (arbitrated on the development drawdown)
not possible: non admissible (arbitrated on the development drawdown, no exception)

bootstrap.statistic: mean of the daily log-return difference candidate - comparator, on the window evaluated
bootstrap.method: stationary bootstrap (Politis and Romano), circular, geometric blocks of the frozen mean length of that comparison

qualification_rules.tc44_admissibility: continuous maximum drawdown <= 50 % on the whole calibration [2021-01-01, 2024-07-01)
qualification_rules.tc44_confidence_interval: published, does not eliminate at this stage
qualification_rules.tc44_not_admissible: the comparison with TC44 is descriptive; the candidate qualifies on its own requirements, with a maximum verdict of "viable sans comparateur admissible" in validation
qualification_rules.on_failure: if the candidate fails any filter, the result is recorded and the bench stops
qualification_rules.sealed_window: not opened in this cycle, whatever the result
text: F1: the candidate continuous maximum drawdown on the whole calibration is <= 50 %

F2: the candidate median realised exposure in its top conviction decile is >= 80 %, on the whole calibration AND separately on the internal verification (score at the close of t, exposure at the close of t+1)
F3: TC44 is admissible if its continuous maximum drawdown on the whole calibration is <= 50 %

F4: if TC44 is admissible, the candidate qualifies only if its annualised net return on the internal verification exceeds TC44 by at least 5 points; the bootstrap interval is published and does not eliminate
F4bis: if TC44 is not admissible, the comparison is descriptive and the candidate qualifies on F1 and F2, with a maximum verdict in validation of "viable sans comparateur admissible"

verdict_rules: protocol v1.3, point 10: admissibility first; decisional comparisons only between admissible policies; T100 enters a verdict only if it respects 50 % itself
verdicts: preuve forte, avantage pratique, viable sans comparateur admissible, non retenue, as written in the protocol
no adjustment of parameter, rule, variant or comparator after the internal verification is read, whatever the results
